title: Build a Memory Match Game
prompt:
Build a memory match card game as a single page.

**Entry:** Preview opens `index.html` — put everything there (inline CSS/JS, or CDN links). No Vite/npm.

Requirements:

- Shows a grid of face-down cards in 8 matching pairs (16 cards)
- Clicking a card flips it face up
- Two face-up cards that match stay up; two that don't flip back after a short pause
- Tracks and shows the number of moves
- Announces a win when all pairs are matched, with a way to play again

Shuffle the deck on every new game. Make it look good — people vote on these.

You're done when you can play a full game start to finish in Preview and start a fresh one.
